'''Orin-Va''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] healer at the [[Shrine of Healing]] on [[Voss]] at the time of the [[Galactic War]]. He and his assistant [[Asha-Mu]] received the [[Voss Mystics|mystic-in-traing]] [[Gaden-Ko]] after he was poisoned by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Shendan]], and at the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor's]] consent, Orin-Va used Voss techniques to share the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] life energy with the Voss.
